name: HaloPSA
description: Creates and manages HaloPSA tickets from Action1 security and operational signals.

actions.label: List Halo Org Client Mappings
actions.description: Loads Action1 organization to Halo client mappings from HaloPSA-owned storage.

actions.label: Save Halo Org Client Mapping
actions.description: Creates or updates a HaloPSA org-to-client mapping row.

actions.label: Delete Halo Org Client Mapping
actions.description: Deletes a HaloPSA org-to-client mapping row.

actions.label: Discover Action1 Mapping Options
actions.description: Loads read-only Action1 organization options for the Mapping screen.

actions.label: Discover Halo Mapping Options
actions.description: Loads read-only Halo client options for the Mapping screen.

actions.label: Discover HaloPSA Settings Options
actions.description: Loads read-only HaloPSA ticket routing options for the settings UI.

actions.label: Validate Configuration
actions.description: Validates HaloPSA connectivity and required configuration.

actions.label: Sync
actions.description: Collects Action1 signals and synchronizes HaloPSA tickets.
